title: Partly functional
body: I found the information on the page was only partly visible and the scroll bar wouldn’t scroll to the end of the page to check all the boxes I needed to. I will delete the app as that just adds to my current situation
author: judemoar

title: Disappointed: encourages self-pity
body: This app seems to victimize those with ADHD by encouraging self-pity. I love that I have ADHD, and I got this app because I wanted a planner, not a calendar. I was disappointed, as the imagery and statements seemed to encourage self-pity rather than empowerment. It didn’t work for me personally.
author: Lilacrocks

title: Neurolist
body: Very handy to generate sub tasks with AI that break the barrier to getting started on any task
author: Xx1dsb chcvj, v

title: Helpful tool
body: Just playing around and testing with the trial but so far so good in breaking down tasks into bite sized activities. Would love to have the app scaled for iPad (to create a home hub) - thanks for your developing work
author: mightygem

title: An absolute game changer
body:
As someone with ADHD and Autism, I’m always struggling to do anything. I’ve tried to write step by step lists, but then I have to think of the steps myself. 
This app changes everything. It generates the prompts through AI, and makes everything so much easier to understand. 
I can’t believe it wasn’t though of earlier, but I am so thankful it exists now. 
The only slight change I would suggest is making it more iPad friendly, as it is much more comfortable to use on a phone. It’s still only new though, and I am thoroughly impressed by it. It’s already my new favourite app. Thank you so much to the developer for making this, I can’t wait to see what is to come.
author: MIKY060

title: The Cure to ADHD
body: This app is awesome! It helps me manage my tasks!
author: Xavier Tepeli

title: Simplicity = game changer; rid mental blocks
body: Yes it’s still in its early stages but it works like it needs to and the ai adding suggestions for subtasks and then make your own if you’d like is perfect for getting to the point. Instead of spending half the energy for a task working out how I’m going to approach it, I can have an ‘assistant’ guide straight to the point!
author: skylarwarner
